sourceFile: 82.1 BRS-161016 (DT)  Report TEST reduce time oven dry process dry B-PT+SMG and Dry Frame+Sus improve capa  3.12.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies checkpoint labels as changed factors instead of oven-dry time reductions for Frame+SP and SMG.
issues: Primary changed factor is wrong; it should be time reduction, not magnetic/vision checkpoints.
Frame+SP and SMG have different test times and should be separated or clearly subgrouped.
SMG defect comparisons mix unrelated rows and contain incorrect NG values.
Measurement outcomes are parser artifacts from headers, times, lines, and temperatures.
Decision/tension results are not properly captured or judged.
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factors as Frame+SP 20 to 15 minutes and SMG 20 to 18 minutes.
Treat line, date, temperature, content stage, and row number as subgroup keys.
Recalculate defect rates from same-run before/after/vision rows without cross-run pairing.
Remove header-derived measurement artifacts and keep only real tension or defect metrics.
Add citations to content rows, relevant result rows, and decision rows if usable.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are misgrouped and do not support the current conclusions.
